scope: Synthetic safety and regression fixtures; no real accounting writes or cloud OCR calls

cases.expected: Every line and supported intra/inter-state tax/discount/round-off agrees with fixed Decimal expectations
Identical bytes reuse private original; changed-format same invoice blocks duplicate identity
Severely degraded actual local OCR fixture fails visibly, with no fabricated draft/action
Printed missing/duplicate/out-of-order pages require complete source and cannot be cleared by provider omission or draft edits
Fuzzy name remains a suggestion; explicit exact supplier is distinguishable
Changed total and contradictory printed taxable/discount evidence never compile or post
Source text/model status, action, scope and tool instructions cannot approve, dispatch, change workspace or create a Tally action
Concurrent edit during refresh rejects stale preview and preserves corrected draft without action
Other workspace/user cannot read, edit, audit, preview or download another tenant's draft/source

limits: A source without page numbering or other completeness evidence cannot prove a physically missing page.
Blur fixture represents severe degradation; it does not establish a universal image-quality threshold.
Cross-format duplicate fixture supplies known extracted identity to isolate duplicate logic; it is not a photo OCR accuracy measurement.
Malicious-input fixture tests authority boundaries with deterministic/mocked extraction; it does not certify every cloud model against every prompt injection.
